programs.title: Jawaab
programs.desc: A journalist on the run from a gangster leaves an envelope with Ramprasad (Raj Babbar) and asks him to deliver it to the police. Subsequently, he is killed. The envelope gets the gangster arrested and Ramprasad begins to receive threats. Changing homes and identities does not help and Ramprasad finally decides to stop running away and face his enemies.

programs.title: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
programs.desc: During the British Raj, upon witnessing the atrocities of the British, Bhagat Singh grows up to be a fierce freedom fighter. His publicised ideas of revolution bring him to as much popularity as Mahatma Gandhi amongst Indians.
